_comment: SPEC.md §10-Q6: 'the file is the signature.' WS-RELSTATE (M4), owned exclusively per §13. Consumed by api/consolidate.js's loadDecayConfig() (frozen, WS-CONSOLIDATE) — that reader is forward-compatible and already ships the identical numbers as its fallback default, so this file's arrival changes nothing at the moment it lands and everything the first time these numbers are edited without touching consolidate.js.
half_life_days_keys_comment: Keys are exactly vy_fact.kind's CHECK enum (db/schema.sql) — consolidate.js's decay loop does `for (const [kind, days] of Object.entries(hl)) update vy_fact ... where kind = $2`, so a key that isn't a real kind is a silent no-op, and a real kind missing here never decays. Do not add or rename keys without checking that enum first.

never_decay.safety_hold: vy_episode.safety_hold = true — excluded from decay entirely, not just slow (§4.1.7, §9.1). Not touched by need_p recompute regardless of kind.
never_decay.identity_kinds: vy_fact kind='meera' (her own continuity facts) carries the longest half-life (180d) rather than true exemption — SPEC §10-Q6 groups 'identity kinds' with phrases as decay-exempt in prose, but the schema has no boolean for it and consolidate.js decays every kind present in half_life_days uniformly. Recorded as a deviation: true exemption would need a code change in consolidate.js (frozen, WS-CONSOLIDATE-owned) to skip kind='meera', or a very long half-life here as the practical substitute, which is what this file does today.
never_decay.phrases: vy_phrase (shared-language ledger) has no need_p column and is never touched by the decay loop — structurally exempt already, no config needed.

decay_semantics: need_p only (SPEC §4.1.7): decay moves ACT-R retrieval priority, never t_invalid, never a delete. Decayed ≠ forgotten — she is honestly fuzzy ('yaad dila na'), never claims deletion. Deletion happens exclusively through forget/DPDP ops (api/memory.js, frozen). Decay and honest-forget must never collide by construction: this file cannot delete anything, only rank it lower.

tier_compaction.trigger: tier-0 episodes older than threshold_days AND importance below the trailing median for that person
tier_compaction.mechanism: collapse into weekly digests citing members via superseded_by back-links; compacted episodes' vy_embedding rows deleted (SPEC §2.5 storage math — embeddings dominate, and a compacted summary gets exactly one new embedding)
tier_compaction.owner: SPEC §4.1.8 names this WS-CONSOLIDATE's nightly-pass step 8; not yet wired in api/consolidate.js as of this file landing (frozen file, out of WS-RELSTATE's edit scope) — schedule recorded here per the interface, wiring is an interface ticket to WS-CONSOLIDATE
